channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Stacey King | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Stacey King from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bill Wennington on Stacey King
item.description:
Bill Wennington on Stacey King:

“I bring this up now at the beginning with the passing of Stacey. It really makes this year different and it's difficult. Even already just at media day seeing K.C. yesterday and knowing that his presence is going to be missed sorely,especially with us because he was such a big part of our family. Heartfelt condolences still to his family, especially his sons who over the years I've gotten to know well. When Stacey was a teammate and they were all our kids were little, as you know K.C. when we first met your kids are little and now you're an empty nester. It's just going to be tough without Stacey this year.”

Bill Wennington on Stacey King, Oct 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Stacey King
item.description:
Taj Gibson:

“What I remember about Stacey King is first, he was just that veteran that was there for me. He was that guy that I could always ask him questionsand he would always give me the greatest answers because it's not often when you can get to a league and you have a veteran that's kind of been in your position where he's coming off the bench, he's doing all the different things and he understands how to be professional. But Stacey took me right underneath the wing. A lot of my highlights, he gave me my nickname. Stacy is like the uncle for me because that's how solid he was from.”

Taj Gibson on Stacey King, Sep 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Stacey King
item.description:
NBA legendMichael Jordan was hit hard by the death of former teammate Stacey King, who died at 59 after a serious fall at his home on Saturday.

“I’m deeply saddened to learn of Stacey’s passing. We shared some special years together as teammates, and he was part of a group that helped define an era of Chicago Bulls basketball,”

Michael Jordan on Stacey King, Jun 9, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Stacey King
item.description:
Jordan said in a statement.

“My thoughts are with Stacey’s family, friends, and everyone whose lives he touched.”

Michael Jordan on Stacey King, Jun 9, 2026. Source: New York Post.
